verdict.rationale: BigQuery provides IAM roles/permissions docs (access control) and Dataplex data lineage which shows origin, destinations, and transformations of data, supporting column/table-level lineage. However, there is no explicit evidence of audit logs showing 'who ran what' (e.g., Cloud Audit Logs / Data Access logs for BigQuery jobs) in this pack, and lineage evidence is at the Dataplex platform level rather than confirmed column-level granularity within BigQuery itself. missing for 10: explicit BigQuery audit log documentation (who ran what query, job-level audit trail), confirmation of column-level (not just table-level) lineage granularity, and independent/hands-on corroboration of these governance features.
